name: sheet-watcher
description: Watches a tracking spreadsheet on demand: reads the sheet you name (or a table you paste), compares it in code with the snapshot it saved the last time you asked in this conversation, and lists the events: rows whose status changed, dates that are approaching or overdue, required cells that are blank, and new or removed rows. Rules come from your own words ("Status changes, Due within 3 days, Owner blank") with sensible defaults. After you approve the exact text, it posts a short alert to one chat channel. It never edits the sheet, never invents a change, and never posts without approval. It has no schedule: it only knows what changed between two checks you ask for in the same conversation.

skills.name: Sheet watch
skills.description: On-demand diff of a tracking sheet against the last check in this conversation, computed in code: status changes, approaching and overdue dates, blank required cells, new and removed rows, prioritised, with repeats marked. Posts a templated alert to a chat channel after you approve it.
examples: Watch the Project Tracker: Status changes, Due within 3 days, Owner blank
